grh_9d9ff4cd3dd879a268b5.title: The Strange Case of the Demon Barber
paragraphs: Actor-manager Mark Humphreys, starring as Sweeney Todd, fears he is committing crimes in a blackout after muddy boots and a bloodied razor keep appearing in his dressing room. Holmes proves the blood is animal, but arrives moments after Humphreys has been murdered with his throat cut; the even wound shows it was staged as suicide. Business manager Derek Lindsay had been planting the evidence to convince Humphreys he was mad and stood to inherit the theater if he died. Holmes makes Lindsay believe Humphreys has survived, then traps him when he attacks after the performance, his greed having made him wait rather than cancel a paying house.

grh_9d670037b5f4abfbd6a9.title: Country of Fear
paragraphs: American graduate student Ruth Rodriguez is arrested while backpacking through an authoritarian South American country after she tries to help a badly beaten man. Secret police isolate and torture her, demanding a false espionage confession that the regime hopes will help secure forty million dollars in U.S. military aid. Her traveling companion, local allies and journalists obtain evidence of her imprisonment, forcing officials to prepare her release while trying to blame everything on Captain Salcido. Ruth sees through the cover-up, and Colonel Mendez offers Salcido's execution in exchange for her silence. She refuses to kill him, reasoning that a living witness to the regime's betrayal can expose the system more effectively, and leaves with the arriving American consul and her friends.
